title: Financial Futures Centre
intro: Explore ideas for thinking about money over the long term. These activities teach concepts, not what you should do with your money.

compound.title: See compounding over time
compound.description: Imagine ₹1,000 stays invested and earns the same rate each year. Move the slider to see how growth can build on earlier growth.
compound.assumption: Assumption: a fixed {rate}% annual rate, compounded yearly. This is a learning example, not a promise; actual outcomes vary.

diversification.title: Think about diversification
diversification.question: A fictional person's savings are exposed to one uncertain outcome. What could spread that exposure?

feedback.one: With everything in one place, one setback can affect all of it.
feedback.spread: Spreading exposure can reduce the effect of one setback, but it cannot remove risk.

horizon.title: Risk and time horizon
horizon.question: A fictional goal is coming up. How much time is there before the money is needed?

feedback.short: When a goal is soon, there is less time to recover from a setback. Time horizon is one factor in understanding risk.
feedback.long: A longer horizon gives more time for ups and downs, but does not make an outcome certain or remove risk.

footer: Educate, do not recommend. No financial product or investment is being suggested.
